_note: Settable water traits (Sonny, 31 Oct 2026, dynasty-water stage a). One kind per field. color is the body tint, clarity_m how deep you can see, turbulence and wave_speed are look only (never feed the sim), density in kg per litre, viscosity is extra linear drag in 1/s, roughness is Manning n, flow_rate multiplies gravity in the flow law (how eagerly it runs), film_m is the depth under which it will not flow (a thin water wets, honey leaves a film), harm_per_s is damage for lava or acid.
